datasets.title: Philippines Displacement - IDPs -Mindanao Earthquake - Site Assessment [IOM DTM]
datasets.description: The dataset contains number of IDPs, families and their needs at sub national level with site coordinates.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-displacement-data-mindanao-earthquake-site-assessment-iom-dtm]

lineage.description: IOM DTM standard methodology was applied to conduct site assessments across Mindanao following earthquake-triggered displacement, collecting counts of internally displaced persons, families, and their humanitarian needs at sub-national and site-specific locations.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.description: DTM (Displacement Tracking Matrix) site assessment data collecting IDP counts, family numbers, and humanitarian needs at displacement sites following the Mindanao earthquake.

resources.title: Philippines Mindanao Earthquakes Site Assessment R5
resources.description: According to the latest DSWD-DROMIC report (Report# 7), 81,629 families or 373,999 persons are affected and 21,495 houses are damaged (4,546 totally destroyed and 26,041 partially damaged). 29,473 families or 130,902 persons are displaced. 57 government-listed IDP sites host 7,873 families or 36,701 persons and 21,600 families or 94,201 persons are otherwise displaced.

resources.title: Philippines Mindanao Earthquakes Site Assessment R1
resources.description: 21,350 people displaced. Majority needs are Food and WASH.
